author: Ruth Derruau
content: Our 1 year old's birthday party was a huge success - there were lots of happy babies and children and so lots of happy parents! The soft play went down brilliantly - many friends commented to say how great it was. It was totally stress-free for us - drop off and collection of the equipment went without a hitch. We are 100% satisfied with Dancing Cubs' service and will definitely hire again. Highly recommend.
